jobs.title: Payments
jobs.description: Embed Payments Solution for SaaS Platforms | Unipaas Embedded financial services Payments Our Payment Embed gives your users a unified, single solution to collect payments via their customers' preferred payment option online or via e-invoices. Make your users’ lives easier with one onboarding, one reporting, and one reconciliation. For all payment methods. If you have multiple payment partners, your users have extra headaches in terms of managing payment methods, reporting, and reconciliation in different places. With Unipaas Embed Payment, your users benefit from a single solution; one onboarding, one reporting interface, one place to manage cards, wallets, Direct Debit, and instant bank transfers, and one solution for reconciliation. Grow revenue with secure card payments Offering cards as a payment method is fundamental to your payments service, but it also needs to be supported in a secure way. ‍ Unipaas supports all major credit cards, including Visa , Mastercard , and American Express , providing a fully compliant and secure solution for seamless payment processing. Integrated with Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), our Payment Embed solution ensures secure transactions while maintaining smooth payment flows, reducing operational friction for your platform and delivering a smooth experience. Capture more revenue with wallets While cards are the incumbent payment method, wallet adoption has been skyrocketing in recent years. Unipaas Embed Payment keeps your platform ahead by offering a wide range of wallets and other payment methods, including Apple Pay and Google Pay . Streamline recurring payments with Direct Debit With many providers, setting up Direct Debit involves a lot of manual work. But if your users depend on recurring payments for their monthly memberships, service fees, or subscriptions, efficiency and automation are key. With our Payment Embed, you can start quickly, setting up mandate requests in days with no paperwork required. Because it is customisable and embedded into your platform, you maintain control over the experience and eliminate the need for third-party websites. And further, you receive real-time mandate and payment status updates, enabling you to proactively address any issues. Lower costs with instant bank transfers In many markets, consumers and businesses are looking at instant bank transfers with open banking as a low-cost, secure alternative to cards. With Unipaas Embed Payment, we offer instant bank transfers to enable direct, secure payments from bank accounts. This frictionless method reduces manual processes and offers immediate access to funds, streamlining the payment journey for platforms. It’s an ideal solution for businesses looking to optimise efficiency and reduce processing time. Learn more about how you can monetise payments with our effortless Subscriptions Embed. jobs.title: Checkout
jobs.description: Checkout Embed Solution for Seamless Transactions | Unipaas Embedded financial services Checkout Our Checkout Embed is a customisable, modular, white-label checkout solution that embeds seamlessly into your interface. Leverage a fully managed checkout, adapted to your specific needs Building payment journeys that customers love is impossible without an amazing checkout experience. But what that experience looks like is different for every platform, marketplace, or merchant. Unipaas Embed Checkout is a modular solution with embedded components that are super easy to integrate. This enables you to build the right payments flow for your specific needs, customised to your look and feel. Deliver a seamless experience through a flexible payments flow Unipaas offers modular white-labelled checkout components that are ready to integrate. With them, you can design tailored payment journeys into your platform. You can implement the Checkout Embed component in full and easily brand it to blend into your interface. Or, you can implement the checkout component only for the payment methods you require, and place them exactly where needed into your software interface. This ensures you'll have an optimised payment journey that your customers love. Provide a customised, native experience A seamless payment experience makes it far more likely that end-customers will convert. Unipaas Embed Checkout is a modular, white-label solution that you can design to be consistent with your brand look and feel. Because it's embedded, there is also no redirect or loading time required to make a payment. This means users don't drop off at the checkout page, driving revenue growth and customer satisfaction. Maximise your payment revenue at checkout with the power of subscriptions Our Unipaas Subscription Embed integrates seamlessly into your platform, supporting all the payment methods your users’ customers prefer. From Direct Debit to credit cards and digital wallets, you can offer a flexible and frictionless payment experience. Effortlessly monetise recurring payments at any checkout, driving consistent revenue growth and customer loyalty. Learn more Rescue failed attempts with decline recovery If a payment does fail at the first attempt, a decline recovery feature automatically retries the transaction with either the same or a different acquirer, leading to a higher rate of successful payments and converting revenue that would otherwise be lost. These two layers of smart logic — for routing and retries — rescue at-risk revenue, helping your users and your business. jobs.title: Pay-by-Link
jobs.description: Pay-by-Link for Easy Payment Collection | Unipaas Embedded financial services Pay-by-Link Accept payments with just a click with Unipaas Embed Pay-by-Link. Take payments wherever your customers are Send secure, one-time payment links by email, SMS, or QR code—perfect for in-person services, remote bookings, or on-the-go transactions. Fast for your customers. Effortless for your team. Say goodbye to hardware and hidden costs No card readers, no clunky devices, no setup headaches. No ongoing fees. Unipaas Embed Pay-by-Link gives you everything you need to start accepting payments—without the overhead. Built for platforms Unipaas Embed Pay-by-Link helps your engineering team save on development time and launch faster - while your customers enjoy a hardware-free, cost-effective way to collect payments. Offer all the ways to pay Boost your conversion rates by supporting every major payment method: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank transfers, and more. All via one smart link. ‍ Explore our unified payment offering Get paid faster, reconcile instantly Embed payment links directly into invoices and let our smart system auto-match incoming payments. Less manual work. Fewer errors. Faster cash flow. ‍ Learn more about Unipaas Embed Invoice Go live in minutes No setup. No training. No friction. No code. You, and your customers, can start collecting payments instantly by generating a link or QR and sharing it. There’s nothing to install, no learning curve. Simple, intuitive and easy to adopt. Seamlessly integrated with our other Embeds, it creates a unified payment ecosystem built for growth. jobs.title: AI-native
jobs.description: AI-Powered Embedded Payment Automation | Unipaas Embedded financial services AI-Native Payments Built with AI at its core, Unipaas intelligently optimises payments across the stack to unlock more volume for your customers. Increase payments adoption with personalised, AI-powered workflows Integrating payments is only half the battle. You need to get your users to use your payment services. For this, we employ AI-driven messaging, tailored to each of your users based on their profile and behaviour on your platform, delivering the right messaging at the right time. The result? More users adopting your payments solution. Convert failed payments into successful ones with a smart, AI-powered checkout If genuine payers experience a failed payment at first attempt, they will be less likely to complete transactions. We have a solution. Our AI-powered declined payment recovery feature automatically retries transactions, routing them to the optimal acquirer. Successfully converting transactions into revenue. Boost your users' payment volume with AI-powered invoicing Unpaid invoices are a key challenge for any business. Our smart invoicing capabilities make your platform stickier and can help you grow payment volume by 3x and more. With our Invoice Embed, your users get paid on time, every time. This product uses a payer's behaviour on your platform to recommend the payment method most likely to result in conversion. Unipaas also enables your users to automate reminders with personalised, AI-powered messages, where they can customise the tone of voice to fit their customers. Unipaas MCP: Agent-ready embedded payments for agentic commerce Unipaas MCP gives platforms a simplified, standardized way to connect AI directly to payment workflows - accelerating time-to-market, and freeing teams to focus on innovation instead of infrastructure. It consolidates the operational layers around embedded payments, covering payment links, transaction handling, payout management, reporting, reconciliation, and more. With Unipaas MCP, platforms can enable AI-driven automation across payment operations without relying on custom logic or fragmented integrations. jobs.description: User Onboarding for Faster Conversions | Unipaas Embedded financial services Onboarding No-hassle onboarding. Get your users accepting payments fast. A decisive, seamless onboarding experience Onboarding is a decisive experience for your users. Figuring out how to make this key functionality seamless can consume considerable time, effort, and resources. Our automated onboarding and no-code building blocks supported by expert customer support get your users up and running in no time. Risk assessment automation for faster onboarding A central part of onboarding are KYC and KYB checks. Time-consuming and often manual, there’s always the chance important information will be missed, slowing down the entire process. We automate these checks while our system pre-populates fields with data from your platform. And we also handle underwriting and regulatory compliance. With 80% automatic approvals, your users can start collecting payments the same day they begin onboarding while ensuring security and quick payment collection. Streamline onboarding with plug and play UI components You want to give your users an onboarding experience that’s specific to their business. Our no-code UI components for onboarding flows are customisable and industry-specific. Giving you the tailored payments offering that will get your users quickly accepting payments, streamlining registration and verification. Our platform can even send automated emails, guiding your users through the registration process. If you’d prefer a fully API custom option for onboarding, or something in between, we can accommodate those as well. Learn more Benefit from expert support Automating and handling risk are important parts of the onboarding process that will streamline it for your users. But we don’t just provide you with the technical tooling to get users up and running quickly. Your users can contact our Customer Success experts directly to learn how to onboard easily, create payment links, and reconcile payments. Freeing up your time to focus on growth and scaling.
